auth.autoSigningInMessage: Signing in automatically with your saved password, please wait…
auth.yanhe2SignInDescription: Use the same campus account you signed in to AutoSlides with. A Yanhe 2.0 session lasts 24 hours.
auth.yanhe2AccountMismatch: That Yanhe 2.0 account isn't {account}. Sign in with the same student ID as AutoSlides.
auth.yanhe2NoToken: No Yanhe 2.0 token found. Paste the _token cookie, or the whole Cookie header.
auth.yanhe2Expired: That Yanhe 2.0 session has expired. Sign in again.
auth.yanhe2Rejected: Yanhe 2.0 did not accept this session.
auth.yanhe2Network: Could not reach Yanhe 2.0. Check your connection and try again.
auth.yanhe2ChallengeExpired: The verification request expired. Sign in again.
auth.smsSentTo: Campus SSO sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. Enter it below to finish signing in.
auth.smsSentToBoundPhone: Campus SSO sent a 6-digit code to your phone. Enter it below to finish signing in.
auth.smsPrivacyNote: This code is only used for this sign-in. Never share it with anyone.

smsError.invalidFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the message.
smsError.code_rejected: That code is incorrect or has expired. Please try again.
smsError.sms_send_failed: The code could not be sent. Please start over.
smsError.risk_rejected: Campus risk control blocked this sign-in. Please sign in with browser.
smsError.network: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.
smsError.unknown: Verification failed. Please try again or sign in with browser.

settings.outputDirectoryBusy: The output folder cannot change while downloads, extractions, tasks, post-processing, slide videos or slide uploads for sharing are running. Let them finish or cancel them, then try again.
settings.connectionModeDescription: Automatic uses the campus intranet whenever it can be reached and the public network otherwise.
settings.slideDetectionDescription: The interval will be automatically adjusted based on playback speed.
settings.slideStabilityDescription: Prevents false detection from animations by confirming a new slide after it remains unchanged for several consecutive checks.
settings.autoPostProcessingDescription: Automatically run post-processing on extracted slides — per slide while watching, or after each automated task completes.
settings.enableAutoPostProcessingLive: Watch Mode (When Each Slide Is Saved)
settings.parallelTasksDescription: How many queued tasks run at once. Post-processing still runs one at a time.
settings.maxManualTabsDescription: Most playback tabs you can open manually at once.

addons.watchNotesDescription: When you watch a lecture and start slide extraction, AutoSlides queues the slides kept after post-processing for your Obsidian note or Notion page.
addons.providerDescription: Choose where watch notes are saved.
addons.providerOffDetail: No notes app is used. Extracted slides stay in your output folder only.
addons.providerObsidianDetail: Slide images are added to the end of a Markdown note in an Obsidian vault. Nothing else is written to the note, and images follow the vault's attachment folder setting.
addons.obsidianVaultDescription: Lecture notes are created in this vault. A note you choose in the Notes panel can be in any vault.
addons.obsidianNotAVault: This folder isn't an Obsidian vault (it has no .obsidian folder). Open it in Obsidian once, or choose another folder.
addons.obsidianFolderDescription: Folder inside the vault for lecture notes. Leave empty to use the vault's top level.
addons.obsidianAutoCreateDescription: When on, each lecture's note is created in the vault as soon as slide extraction starts. When off, choose Create Lecture Note or Choose Note… in the Notes panel.
addons.providerNotionDetail: Slide images are added to the end of a Notion page you choose for each lecture. Nothing else is written to the page.
addons.notionNotConnected: Notion isn't connected yet, so no watch notes will be created.
addons.notionStep1: Open {link}, click New connection, choose Access token as the authentication method, and click Create connection.
addons.notionStep2: On the Configuration tab, under Integration token, copy the Access token and paste it below. Keep Read content and Insert content checked under Capabilities.
addons.notionStep3: On the Content access tab, click Edit access and select the top-level pages AutoSlides may add slides to. Their sub-pages are included.
addons.notionStep4: For each lecture, choose the page in the Notes tab of the right panel.
addons.notionErrorUnauthorized: Notion didn't accept this token. Copy the Access token again from the connection's Configuration tab.
addons.notionErrorNetwork: Couldn't reach Notion. Check your network and try again.
addons.notionErrorOther: Notion couldn't check the token right now. Try again later.
addons.toolsDescription: Show Web Capture and Yuketang in the sidebar, below Workspace.
addons.webCaptureDescription: Open any web page in a built-in browser and extract slides from the video playing on it.
addons.yuketangDescription: Export a lesson's slides from the Yuketang (雨课堂) platform as a PDF or images.
addons.cliDescription: Use AutoSlides from a terminal. Installing adds two small launcher scripts: yhdl runs this copy of AutoSlides without opening a window, and autoslides hands its commands to the open app.
addons.cliAllowControlDescription: Let autoslides commands, typed by you or an AI agent, look up courses and sessions and queue downloads in this app as your signed-in account. yhdl works either way.
addons.cliUsageAppDownload: Queue a lecture in the Download panel and wait for it. Ctrl-C stops waiting; the download keeps going.
addons.cliUsageAppDownloads: With no action, list the Download panel. wait follows unfinished downloads to the end; cancel and retry are the panel's buttons (name a session, or use --all); clear removes finished and failed rows.
addons.cliUsageAppConfig: Show or change the settings the commands follow: output folder, connection, downloads and extraction after download, as Save here would. Works while signed out. Example: autoslides config connection_mode internal.
addons.cliSkillDescription: Teaches an AI agent, such as Claude Code, to use these commands. Copy the prompt and paste it into your agent: it links the skill folder below, which AutoSlides refreshes when it updates.
addons.cliSkillScopePersonalHint: The agent installs the skill for you, so it can use it in every project.
addons.cliSkillScopeProjectHint: The agent installs the skill only in the project it is working in, so other projects never load it.
addons.cliUsageSearch: Find courses by name, teacher or course ID, in the current term or, with --term, any term since Fall 2023. No sign-in needed.
addons.cliUsageMine: List the courses you are enrolled in. Uses your AutoSlides sign-in.
addons.cliUsageCourse: Show a course and list its sessions. Listing sessions uses your AutoSlides sign-in.
addons.cliUsageSession: Show one session and which recordings it has. No sign-in needed.
addons.cliUsageLink: A session link downloads it; a course link shows the course and its sessions. A bare id needs its command.
addons.cliOptCourse: Download every recorded session of a course. Uses your sign-in to list them.
addons.cliOptJson: Print one JSON result, for scripts and AI agents.
addons.cliOptToken: Use this login token for this run instead of your AutoSlides sign-in. Also read from YANHEKT_TOKEN.
addons.cliUsageDownload: Download a recorded Yanhekt lecture as an .mp4. No sign-in needed.
addons.cliOptStream: Which recording to download. Default: screen.
addons.cliOptOutput: Save to this folder for this run instead of the AutoSlides output folder.
addons.cliOptIntranet: Use the campus intranet route. Default: public network.
addons.cliOptInterface: With --intranet: send from this network interface instead of the one set in AutoSlides.
addons.cliOptForce: Download again even if the file already exists.
addons.cliUsageUmbrella: The same commands, run inside the app as your signed-in account and under its settings, so without --token, --account, --output, --intranet or --interface. Starts the app if needed; with no arguments, just opens it.
addons.cliPathHint: The commands won't be found until their folder is on your PATH. Run this in a terminal:
addons.cliPathUnknown: If a command isn't found, run this in a terminal to add its folder to your PATH:
addons.cliPathHintWindows: The commands won't be found until their folder is on your PATH. Run this in PowerShell, then open a new terminal:
addons.cliForeign: Another file named {name} is already in that folder, so it was left untouched.
addons.cliUnsupportedDev: Commands can only be installed from a packaged build.
addons.cliUnsupportedTranslocated: Move AutoSlides to the Applications folder and reopen it before installing commands.

advanced.rememberPasswordDescription: Save the password each time you sign in with SSO, and offer it the next time. Turning this off deletes every saved password.
advanced.autoSignInDescription: When a saved session has expired, sign in with the saved campus password. This also renews an expired Yanhe 2.0 session. If a verification code is required, the sign-in window opens; otherwise sign-in finishes in the background. Requires Remember Password.
advanced.passwordDescription: Save a password for this account. It is offered the next time you sign in with SSO.
advanced.passwordSaveFailed: Couldn't save the password. This computer can't encrypt it.
advanced.tokenDescription: Manually input your authentication token for direct access.
advanced.yanhe2CookiesDescription: The JWT for this account. Paste a JWT, the _token cookie, or a Cookie header to replace it. Kept on this device.
advanced.yanhe2SignInWithMainDescription: When you sign in with campus SSO, sign in to Yanhe 2.0 in the same step. No second password or verification code.
advanced.pngColorReductionDescription: Reduce PNG colours to 128 to significantly decrease file size (50-70% smaller) with minimal visual quality loss.
advanced.ssimDescription: Higher global structural similarity threshold indicate stricter matching.
advanced.ssimWarning: Adjust ONLY IF NECESSARY, as a minor change of 0.001 can significantly impact performance.

classroomRules.title: Adaptive Classroom Rules
classroomRules.description: When using Adaptive mode, SSIM threshold is automatically adjusted based on classroom location:
classroomRules.reason: These buildings have older equipment and poorer screen recording quality, requiring a more lenient threshold.

advanced.pHashDescription: Hamming distance threshold for pHash comparison in post-processing. Lower values indicate stricter similarity detection.
advanced.aiFilteringReminder: AI can make mistakes. You can review results later in Slides.

autoCrop.title: Auto Crop
autoCrop.description: Tune slide-canvas detection used by the Auto Crop workflow. Defaults work for most recordings; lower the aspect tolerance for stricter matches.
autoCrop.detectorModeDescription: Choose how the slide canvas is located. The fallback mode runs Canny first and only invokes the YOLO model when Canny fails.
autoCrop.cannyThenYolo: Use Canny First, Then Fall Back to YOLO
autoCrop.aspectToleranceDescription: Maximum allowed deviation from 16:9 or 4:3 when matching the detected slide aspect ratio.
autoCrop.blackThresholdDescription: Maximum pixel luminance (0-255) treated as black when stripping letterbox borders.
autoCrop.maxBorderFracDescription: Upper limit of black border removed from each side, as a fraction of the image dimension.
autoCrop.cannyLowThresholdDescription: Lower threshold for Canny edge detection used to locate slide edges.
autoCrop.cannyHighThresholdDescription: Upper threshold for Canny edge detection used to locate slide edges.
autoCrop.areaRatioMinDescription: Minimum slide area relative to the full frame. Candidates smaller than this are rejected.
autoCrop.areaRatioMaxDescription: Maximum slide area relative to the full frame. Candidates larger than this are rejected.
autoCrop.marginFracDescription: Fractional margin added around the detected slide bounding box before cropping.
autoCrop.fillRatioMinDescription: Minimum ratio of the candidate bounding box area to its convex hull area.

yolo.title: YOLO Parameters
yolo.confidenceThresholdDescription: Minimum detection confidence [0.05–0.95] before a candidate is kept.
yolo.iouThresholdDescription: IoU threshold used by non-max suppression to de-duplicate overlapping boxes.
yolo.inputSizeDescription: Square input size (pixels) the image is letterboxed to before inference.

model.title: Model
model.hint: Selecting a custom model replaces the built-in one for auto-crop. Deleting reverts to built-in.

aiBehaviour.title: AI Behaviour
aiBehaviour.distinguishDescription: When enabled, AI treats presentation edit-mode frames (PowerPoint/Keynote/Google Slides in editing view) as a separate class rather than merging them into non-slide frames. These frames are moved to the bin as "AI Filtered – Edit" and can be restored and auto-cropped later.

advanced.pHashExclusionDescription: Manage a list of image hashes to exclude from slide detection. Images matching these hashes will be ignored during post-processing.
advanced.clearExclusionListMessage: Are you sure you want to clear all exclusion items?
advanced.clearExclusionListDetail: This will remove all items from the pHash exclusion list. This action cannot be undone.
advanced.enterNamePlaceholder: Enter a name for this exclusion item…
advanced.downsamplingDescription: Downsample images before SSIM calculation for anti-aliasing to improve detection accuracy.
advanced.videoErrorDescription: Number of retry attempts when video playback errors occur. Applies to Yanhekt.
advanced.videoTokenRefreshDescription: How often the player re-fetches the anti-hotlink video token while streaming. The token stays valid for about 10 minutes, so a longer interval means fewer token requests. Applies to Yanhekt.
advanced.preferMicAudioDescription: Some lectures include a separate classroom microphone recording, which is often clearer than the room audio. It is silent when the teacher did not wear the microphone. Applies to Yanhekt and Yanhe 2.0.
advanced.enablePreferMicAudio: Select mic audio when a lecture has it
advanced.checkMicAudioDescription: Mic audio is listed even when the microphone was off during the lecture. With this on, the track is sampled when a lecture opens and offered only if speech is found, so the option appears a moment later. Applies to Yanhekt and Yanhe 2.0.
advanced.enableCheckMicAudio: Hide mic audio that has no speech
advanced.yanhe2CaptionsDescription: Yanhe 2.0's caption times are off by an amount that differs from lecture to lecture. AutoSlides can measure it from the recording's audio; this downloads a few minutes of video the first time captions or the transcript are used on a lecture. A lecture that cannot be measured gets no captions. Applies to Yanhe 2.0.
advanced.yanhe2CaptionDelayDescription: Applied to every lecture. This is a guess, not a measurement: 24 seconds matched one lecture, and another may need a different value. A negative number shows captions earlier.
advanced.showMorePlaybackSpeedDescription: Show the full playback speed list in the playback page. Applies to Yanhekt and Yanhe 2.0.
advanced.resumeServerProgressDescription: Start recorded lectures at the position Yanhekt has for your account, and keep it updated while you watch. Watching only — queued tasks always start from the beginning. Applies to Yanhekt.
advanced.enableResumeServerProgress: Resume recordings from your Yanhekt position
advanced.resumeServerProgressLectures: Resume Where You Left Off in Lectures
advanced.resumeServerProgressLecturesDescription: Same for the Lectures player, local files and online streams alike. Requires sign-in. Applies to Yanhekt.
advanced.enableResumeServerProgressLectures: Resume lectures from your Yanhekt position
advanced.preventSystemSleepDescription: Prevent the system from going to sleep during video playback to avoid interruptions. Applies to Yanhekt and Yanhe 2.0.
advanced.homePreviewFromVideoDescription: Capture a frame from the screen recording to use as the Home page preview. When disabled, cards show a cover image instead.
advanced.homePreviewSeekDescription: How many seconds into the latest recording to capture the preview frame.

qtExtractor.title: Auto Extraction After Download
qtExtractor.titleDescription: Speed up slide extraction by running the external AutoSlides Extractor on each finished screen recording. It extracts slides from local video files with hardware acceleration support, which is faster than capturing slides during live playback.
qtExtractor.autoRun: Run C++ Slide Extraction Automatically After Download
qtExtractor.sectionDescription: AutoSlides Extractor is a standalone C++ application. Install it separately, then point this field at the executable.
qtExtractor.sourceLink: See the GitHub repository for details.
qtExtractor.pathPlaceholder: Not detected — click Refresh or Browse to pick a path
qtExtractor.noUpdateMessage: AutoSlides Extractor is up to date.
qtExtractor.noUpdateDetail: You are using the latest version (v{currentVersion}).
qtExtractor.updateCheckFailedMessage: Could not check for AutoSlides Extractor updates.

advanced.concurrentDownloadDescription: Maximum number of simultaneous downloads and processing.
advanced.downloadMaxWorkersDescription: Number of concurrent connections per download for fetching video segments.
advanced.cacheManagementDescription: Manage Chromium HTTP/code caches, webview caches, preview thumbnails, lecture posters, update downloads, and log files. Sign-in and settings are not affected.
advanced.clearCacheMessage: Are you sure you want to clear all cache files?
advanced.clearCacheDetail: This removes the HTTP disk cache (including leftover video segments), compiled JS/WASM, GPU shader caches, webview caches, thumbnails, lecture posters, and downloaded updates. Settings, accounts, and slides are not deleted.
advanced.resetAllDataMessage: This will completely reset the application to factory settings.
advanced.resetAllDataDetail: All settings, cache and user data will be permanently deleted; the log files are kept. This action cannot be undone.
advanced.finalConfirmationMessage: Are you absolutely sure you want to reset ALL data?
advanced.finalConfirmationDetail: This will delete everything and the application will restart as if newly installed.
advanced.resetSuccess: Application data has been reset successfully
advanced.restartRequiredMessage: The application needs to restart to complete the reset.
advanced.restartRequiredDetail: AutoSlides restarts when you click 'Restart Now'.
advanced.intranetInterfaceDescription: Bind intranet-mode traffic to a specific local network interface. This applies ONLY to requests routed through intranet mode; all other traffic uses the system default route.
advanced.intranetInterfaceNotFound: Selected interface is not currently available. Intranet traffic will use the system default until it is reconnected.
advanced.intranetMappingDescription: Domains and the campus addresses used for them on the intranet route. They are read from the campus DNS when it answers, and from a built-in list otherwise.
advanced.intranetTestHint: Checks from this computer whether each address answers, and how fast.
advanced.intranetSourceBuiltIn: Built-in addresses (the campus DNS did not answer)
advanced.proxyDescription: Choose how each group of sites is reached. Campus addresses and this computer are always reached without a proxy. System Proxy follows your operating system's proxy settings, or the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable when the system names none.
advanced.proxyCampusDescription: Yanhekt, Yanhe 2.0 and the campus sign-in. If you use a proxy tool, consider adding direct rules for yanhekt.cn and bit.edu.cn.
advanced.proxyOtherDescription: AI services, AutoSlides' own services, app updates, Notion, Yuketang and Web Capture.
advanced.proxyCustomUrlDescription: Used by every group set to Custom: http://, https:// or socks5:// with a host and port.
advanced.proxyCustomUrlInvalid: This is not a proxy address. Until it is fixed, those requests connect without a proxy.
advanced.preferAnonymousApiRequestsDescription: When possible, omit the login token on public catalogue, search, course metadata, and video-token requests. Personal lists, session lists, subscriptions, notes, and account APIs still send your token.
advanced.localRelayDescription: Expose a LAN HTTP server with the same API as the public relay (GET /playlist and GET /segment) so other devices can stream recorded lectures through this machine. Optional intranet routing applies when Internal Network mode is on. In-app playback is unchanged.
advanced.localRelayWhitelistEnableDescription: When enabled, only listed tokens (and optionally the current account token) may use the relay. Disable only on trusted networks.
advanced.localRelayWhitelistInvalid: Token must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
advanced.localRelayWhitelistDuplicate: That token is already on the list.
advanced.localRelayWhitelistIsCurrent: The current account token is already covered by the pin above.

ai.serviceTypeDescription: Choose a service: the built-in option (shared service, so availability may fluctuate), GitHub Copilot, or a custom OpenAI-compatible API. Custom service docs:
ai.modelNotLoggedIn: Please log in to view model info
ai.cloudflareHint: To use the built-in AI service, please disable your proxy or VPN and try again.
ai.rateLimitBuiltinHint: Request settings and completion parameters for the built-in service are managed by the server and cannot be changed.
ai.rateLimitCustomHint: To avoid hitting ModelScope's API rate limit, we recommend setting Max Concurrent Requests to 1 and Min Time Between Requests to 6000ms.
ai.requestSettingsHint: Batch Size and Image Size should be configured based on your vLLM context window, as larger values may trigger 413 Payload Too Large errors.
ai.completionParamsHint: Optional chat-completion body fields. Uncheck Send to omit a key from the request JSON (some providers treat missing vs present differently).
ai.maxTokensNote: Max tokens the model may generate in one reply.
ai.topPNote: Nucleus sampling. Lower focuses on higher-probability tokens.
ai.streamNote: Not configurable. Classification always uses a full JSON response (non-streaming).
ai.enableThinkingHint: Sent as chat_template_kwargs.<selected key>. Some models use enable_thinking; others use thinking. Off recommended so max_tokens is not spent on reasoning.
ai.thinkingCopilotNote: GitHub Copilot does not use thinking kwargs; omitted from the request.
ai.variantSimpleHint: You are editing the prompts used when "Distinguish may_be_slide" is off.
ai.variantDistinguishHint: You are editing the prompts used when "Distinguish may_be_slide" is on.
ai.promptLiveDescription: Processes one image at a time. Expected response:
ai.promptRecordedDescription: Processes multiple images in batch. Expected response:
ai.builtinDisclaimer: This service is provided by the developer free of charge and on an "as is" basis. We make no warranties, express or implied, regarding the continuity or stability of the service, and we may modify or interrupt the service at any time without prior notice. The user agrees to use the service in a reasonable, fair, and non-commercial manner.
ai.copilotInvalidToken: Invalid token. Please check and try again.
ai.copilotDeviceCodeExpired: Device code expired. Please try again.
ai.rateLimitCopilotHint: GitHub Copilot has its own rate limits. Recommended: Max Concurrent 1, Min Time 6000ms.

ml.classifierModeDescription: Choose how image classification runs: LLM API mode uses a cloud AI service, while ML mode runs a local machine-learning model on your device.
ml.modelHint: The default model downloads when needed and works offline afterwards. You can also choose a custom ONNX model.
ml.modelDownloadFailed: Couldn’t download the classifier model. Check your connection and try again.
ml.modelActionFailed: Couldn’t update the classifier model. Try again.
ml.thresholdsHint: Adjust how aggressively AutoSlides removes images it suspects are not slides. Keep: the system is unsure, so the image is kept. Delete: the system is highly confident the image is not a slide, so it is removed. Review: confidence is in-between; the image is kept or removed using the secondary "Is a Slide" probability slider below.
ml.slideCheckSliderLabel: Secondary Filter: "Is a Slide" Probability (Review zone only)

ai.modelChainHint: Models are tried in order. If a model hits its daily quota (HTTP 429), the next enabled model is used automatically. Exhausted state resets when the app restarts.
ai.modelChainAddPlaceholder: Enter model name or pick a preset…
ai.modelChainEmpty: No models in chain. Add one below to enable AI classification.

advanced.developerModeDescription: Enable Developer Mode for verbose logging.
advanced.searchSourceYanhektDescription: Yanhekt's own search. It often lists loosely related courses as well.
advanced.searchSourceLocalDescription: Searches the course index downloaded to this computer, as of last night. Needs Keep the Course Index Up to Date.
advanced.searchSourceOnlineDescription: Searches the AutoSlides Index at share.ruc.edu.kg, as of last night. Needs a connection.
advanced.searchSourceLocalThenOnlineDescription: Uses the course index on this computer when it has the term, else the AutoSlides Index.
advanced.searchSourceOnlineOnlyDescription: Always asks the AutoSlides Index. Nothing is read from this computer.
advanced.courseIndexAutoUpdate: Keep the Course Index Up to Date
advanced.courseIndexAutoUpdateDescription: Downloads the current term every day, and any earlier term that changed. Clear Cache removes the downloads; the copy that ships with the app stays.
advanced.currentTermLocalNeedsUpdates: With updates off, the current term can only be searched on this computer once it has been downloaded.
advanced.courseIndexHeld: {count} term on this computer, data from {date}. | {count} terms on this computer, data from {date}.
advanced.courseIndexNone: No course index on this computer yet.
advanced.courseIndexNoKey: This build has no course index key, so the course index on this computer is off.
advanced.closeToTrayDescription: Closing the window hides it instead of quitting. Downloads, tasks and autoslides commands keep running. Click the tray icon to open the window again, or choose Quit from its menu.
advanced.closeToTrayMac: Keep Running When the Window Is Closed
advanced.closeToTrayMacDescription: Closing the window hides it instead of closing it. Downloads, tasks and autoslides commands keep running. Click AutoSlides in the Dock to open the window again, or press ⌘Q to quit.

welcome.title: Welcome to AutoSlides
welcome.subtitle: AutoSlides is a tool designed for BIT students.

gallery.trashFailedAll: Failed to move slides to the bin: {error}

playback.networkProblems: This may be due to video quality issues or network problems. Consider downloading this video for offline viewing to avoid playback interruptions.
playback.browserNotSupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.
playback.taskInProgress: Task in progress. Controls are disabled. If you exit, the task queue will be paused and current task progress will be lost. To adjust settings, please manually pause the task list.
